verdict.scope: the offline core boundary of 4630bca only (no server, client, logging, analytics or share surface exists in this repository and none was verified)
verdict.summary: Every finding behind SB-1..SB-5 is closed at its cause and verified by my own probes against 5ee9dec: a new stop after resumed training is screened on its own; a sign under a reused event id routes clinically and writes its hold; unreadable, foreign, malformed, orphan or later rows hold on both the review and the restart path, with counts only; every clinical decision returns a readable unreleased CLINICAL_HOLD (non-string ids are refused); the default restart asks and no malformed input throws. SEC-V1CPR-05 and -06, OBS-R1 and OBS-R2 are closed. The guidance level is derived only from items answered yes, never enters a record row or the reference state as a field, and every clinical route carries it. Rows stay append-only and sealed; LEX-3 text never lowers an outcome. One new privacy regression (the per-condition improved object echoes an unknown key, free text included, into the output and the reference state) and one safety-relevant gap outside my authority (an urgent sign during a standing clinical reference is answered by the generic guard) are NON_BLOCKING for this offline candidate and bound as conditions. CF-OBS-1 is not blocking for this candidate and is a condition before any integration.

newFindings.title: The per-condition improved object echoes an unknown key, free text included, into the decision and the reference state
files: CoachingCore/src/v1-f08.mjs readCheck: bad.push('wellbeingCheck.improved.'+k) for a key not in open; the ASK reason joins bad
newFindings.scenario: Open report; WELLBEING_CHECK or weekly-review check with improved {NEED_REST:true, ZEBRA_CANARY_TEXT:true} (or a 2,000-character key 'MY_DOCTOR_SAID_I_HAVE_MYOCARDITIS_...'): ASK with missingInputs ['wellbeingCheck.improved.<key>'], the key repeated in the reason and stored in referenceState.pending (missingInputs and reason); output 52 KB (p3, p6). 5ee9dec gave missingInputs ['wellbeingCheck.improved'] with no echo (p6).
newFindings.impact: A free-text channel into persisted, health-adjacent state and into any log that records reasons; regresses the property verified under SEC-V1CPI-08 and SEC-V1CP-05 (unknown keys are never echoed). No record row is written by the ASK.
newFindings.smallestFix: In readCheck, report keys outside open as one 'wellbeingCheck.improved.unrecognized' (count only), as unrecognized() does; directed canary test (no canary in output, reference state or record).

newFindings.severity: MEDIUM (safety relevance; classification of the sporting/clinical severity belongs to SSCTR and QRE)
newFindings.classification: NON_BLOCKING for the security gate; routed

newFindings.title: An urgent sign answered during a standing clinical reference is answered by the generic guard: no urgent guidance, the sign is not recorded
files: CoachingCore/src/r6-adaptation.mjs previousValidity (pending CLINICAL returns before the handlers read the payload) and evaluateProgram's guard call
newFindings.scenario: Hold opened by W7 at entry (PROFESSIONAL_ASSESSMENT). A later NOT_FEELING_100 with W2 yes, reference sent: CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, guidance PROFESSIONAL_ASSESSMENT, reason 'A prior clinical dependency remains ...', no row records W2. The same review without the reference: URGENT_CARE_ADVISED (p3). A replay of a W2 check with the reference: PROFESSIONAL_ASSESSMENT (p6); a stale clinical reference with W2: PROFESSIONAL_ASSESSMENT (p2, SB-4d).
newFindings.impact: No training is planned (the hold stands and is on record), so no trust boundary fails; but a potentially serious sign gets the non-urgent wording and leaves no trace, the opposite of SSCTR-FF-Q9's mapping ('at entry, at a check ...') and of D5's proportional-urgency instruction, and the better outcome depends on the client omitting the reference.
newFindings.smallestFix: Before the CLINICAL guard, read signsYesIn of the review's wellbeing, wellbeingCheck or readiness payload; on any yes return signRoute (its guidance) and keep the hold, as SB-2 does for a reused id; directed test with the reference sent.
newFindings.routing: SSCTR (whether FF-Q9 requires the urgent level here) and QRE; Chief to judge whether TASK_CONTRACT_FF ESCALATE_IF 'a relevant sign ignored' applies in this narrow form. If SSCTR says yes it is a narrow runtime-only fix eligible for the single cycle.

newFindings.introducedByCandidate: partly (race row fields and 'unwell' marker are new)
newFindings.title: Health-derived state now lives in the program object and the reference state, outside the F08 record
newFindings.scenario: After a MILD_ILLNESS report in the race week: race row explanation 'The coach does not plan a race while you are unwell ...', ownEvent true, coachRecommendation; WELLBEING_REDUCTION markers with unwell, phase, rungs, episode; the program JSON holds 'unwell' 7 times (p3). referenceState.pending.reason holds sign names and 'urgent' wording (p3).
newFindings.impact: Any surface that renders or shares the plan (Growth Layer plan-week and post-workout artefacts, exports, notifications, analytics, crash reports) can disclose a health state without touching an F08 row.
newFindings.smallestFix: Inventory and egress rule, not a core change: list these fields in SEC-V1CP-01 and strip them from every share, export, analytics, log and OS surface (SEC-V1CP-09, -15..-18).

newFindings.title: inputHash (and rowHash) are unsalted digests of small closed payloads: a dropped answer is recoverable
newFindings.scenario: The early 'improved false' kept as null in the clear is recovered from the check row's inputHash by hashing three candidate payloads (p3).
newFindings.smallestFix: Treat both digests as the payload for retention, erasure, export and logging (already SEC-V1CP-15), or move to a keyed digest under RECORD-CUSTODY.

newFindings.title: A record that is not an array is read as no record on the restart path
newFindings.scenario: restartProgram with record {} or null: PROPOSED from the cold start (p1); with a hold on record sent as {rows:[...]} the hold is not read (ASK for an unrelated input, p2). Equivalent to withholding the record.
newFindings.smallestFix: A record that is present and not an array gives HOLD 'malformed:record'; with RECORD-CUSTODY the server always sends the stored record.

cfObs1.classification: NON_BLOCKING for this offline candidate; CONDITION before any integration (C2); not acceptable as the protocol's contract alone
evidence: Hold on record (W7), no reference: WEEKLY_REVIEW KEEP with a proposal of 30 live sessions ahead, MISSED_SESSION MODIFY, SYSTEMIC_FATIGUE MODIFY; with the reference all are CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED; the returned reference after the no-reference review has pending null (p4).
The record keeps the hold: a restart from it still gives CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, and a readiness declaration reads it (p4; QRE-V1CPR-08 test).
Same class, pre-existing at 5ee9dec: an identical replay of a W2 check without the reference is KEEP with a clean reference (p6).
cfObs1.reasoning: The core now treats the record hold as authoritative for restarts and readiness but not for the other reviews, so a client that drops the reference state plans training over an unreleased clinical hold. In my previous record this was a condition of SEC-V1CPI-03 under RECORD-CUSTODY; it needs a client or server fault, the record keeps the fact, and the offline core has no integration, so it does not block this candidate. Relying on custody alone leaves a silent fail-open for any future integrator, so the narrow core fix is preferred.
